kuyumcum.title: Kuyumcum
kuyumcum.summary: A mobile ecosystem connecting precious-metal holdings, portfolio insight and local merchants. I co-developed the product and engineered its AI features.
kuyumcum.description: How I co-developed a Flutter product for precious metals and engineered on-device recognition and multi-agent reports.

water-safety.title: HealthFactor-AI
water-safety.summary: My two-layer machine-learning research on İzmir’s public water-quality data: current contamination detection and safety-trend forecasting, with real and synthetic evaluation kept distinct.
water-safety.description: My two-layer water-safety ML research on İzmir open data: chronological evaluation, synthetic-data limits and an accepted IJEA paper.
water-safety.role: Two-layer framework, data pipeline and models
water-safety.metricLabel: water-quality measurements from 76 sampling points, August 2025 – July 2026
mediaAlt: Daily and monthly mean Health Factor of İzmir water samples, August 2025 to August 2026

course-intelligence.title: Course Intelligence RAG
course-intelligence.searchTitle: Course Intelligence RAG — local LLM retrieval
course-intelligence.summary: I built a local RAG assistant for departmental knowledge with Llama 3.1, SBERT and FAISS: semantic retrieval, traceable context and deliberately constrained answers.
course-intelligence.description: How I built a local RAG assistant with Llama 3.1, SBERT and FAISS: retrieval, constrained answers and evaluation limits.

taskfoo.title: TaskFoo
taskfoo.summary: I built project, epic and task workflows with role-based controls and PostgreSQL persistence during my VBT Software internship.

urban-mobility.title: İzmir urban mobility
urban-mobility.summary: A three-person course project (CE 477): we explored 25,775 daily İzmirim Kart ridership rows, by operator and fare type, from January 2021 to April 2025 with clustering, seasonal features and demand forecasting.
mediaAlt: Four DBSCAN clusters and noise in the ridership data, shown on its first two principal components

pam.title: Pluggable authentication
pam.summary: A four-person course project: a Java authentication interface for Local, LDAP and Kerberos providers, kept extensible with adapter and factory patterns.

gymrap-ai-coach.title: GymRap AI Coach
gymrap-ai-coach.searchTitle: GymRap AI Coach — authenticated MCP tools
gymrap-ai-coach.summary: I built a personal strength coach end to end on Health Connect, Cloudflare and an OAuth-protected MCP server. Tested, deterministic analysis runs on the server; ChatGPT reads it through MCP and writes the coaching.
gymrap-ai-coach.description: How I built an OAuth-protected MCP coach with Health Connect and deterministic server-side analysis; ChatGPT interprets the results.
gymrap-ai-coach.role: Design and implementation, end to end
mediaAlt: Daily coach report email, rendered from synthetic data
Post-workout report email, rendered from synthetic data
Heart-rate zones and weekly sets per muscle group, rendered from synthetic data

carbonpilot.title: CarbonPilot AI
carbonpilot.summary: A five-person Google AI & Technology Academy graduation project: carbon accounting for CBAM exporters with deterministic emission calculations and a guarded LangGraph agent. My part: the agent graph with loop, timeout and fallback guards, Gemini extraction, LangSmith tracing and the PDF/JSON reports.

voiceops.title: VoiceOps
voiceops.summary: A Google hackathon project: a Turkish voice assistant for warehouse staff that turns speech into Gemini function calls over stock data. My part was the application scaffold.
